description: Shenzhen-founded consumer 3D printing brand (founded 2015) selling FDM and resin printers, filament and accessories worldwide through its own store; it promotes a creator-facing affiliate program on its store site and also runs a US program on Awin.

evidence.summary: Anycubic's own affiliate page (fetched) offers a minimum of 5% commission on every qualifying order, monthly bonuses and exclusive rate increases for top performers, a 60-day cookie window, free joining and approval usually within 2-3 business days; it explicitly invites makers, 3D printing fans and content creators, and publishes the program contact taylorwang@anycubic.com. The page makes no statement about a cap on total earnings, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Awin hosts live program terms for 'Anycubic (US)', confirming a network route alongside the brand's own page. Lasso's listing for the company shows 4% with a 30-day cookie, which conflicts with the brand's own published minimum of 5% and 60-day cookie, so the brand's official figures are recorded. No creator-count figure is published anywhere fetched, so saturation is unknown.

opportunity.title: Anycubic Affiliate Program (own program / Awin US)

reasons.compensation: Minimum 5% commission with monthly bonuses and rate increases for top performers and a 60-day cookie, per the brand's own page; no cap statement is published, so the cap stays unknown.

reasons.opportunity_availability: Free, open application on the brand's own page with approval typically in 2-3 business days; a US program also runs on Awin.
reasons.credibility: Major global desktop 3D printing brand founded in Shenzhen in 2015, selling in over 200 countries.
